name: 62948 · Herrin, IL
findings: ZIP 62948 (Herrin) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62948 (Herrin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
